name: improve-codebase-architecture
title_zh: 扫描代码库，把架构隐患变成可视化报告
tagline_zh: 别等重构时才后悔。一眼看清代码库哪里在腐烂，点开就能深挖，像给项目做一次带图的体检。
tagline_en: Stop refactoring blind. See exactly where your codebase is rotting, then click into any spot to dig deeper.
desc_en: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.
why_zh: 不是列清单，而是把发现变成可交互的 HTML 报告，选中哪块就追问到底，逼你把问题想透。
why_en: It doesn't just list issues—it turns findings into an interactive HTML report and interrogates you on whichever one you choose.
limit_zh: 只对本地 Git 仓库有效，且需要 Node.js 18+。报告是静态快照，不追踪后续改动；深挖靠对话，不自动改代码。
limit_en: Local Git repos only, requires Node.js 18+. Report is a static snapshot—no live tracking; deep-dive is conversational, no auto-fixes.
